purpose: Add an owner-triggered aggregate-only READ ONLY REG.RU preflight for W1-A Organization Capability Authority so production migration state is measured before any migration or broader release is authorized.
requiredInvariants: Production database access is one REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY transaction and PRODUCTION_DATABASE_MUTATION=0.
The preflight may report repository migration names and aggregate counts only; it emits no tenant, organization, membership, user or registration identifiers.
No migration, deploy, backfill, capability grant, external call or partner message is performed.

A later isolated W1-A migration may be authorized only when the target migration is the sole repository migration pending in production, or when the target is already applied and schema invariants are intact.
acceptance: The exact current main SHA and deployed API revision are recorded without changing runtime.
Repository migration directories are compared with the production Prisma migration ledger in READ ONLY mode.
The target migration 20260904120000_organization_capability_authority is classified as applied, sole-pending or blocked by other pending migrations.
Target table presence, row counts and FORCE RLS flags are measured without mutation.
Immutable evidence is uploaded and the decision is written back to issue #4997.
